title: Writing Task 1: Overview Paragraph
topic: Menulis paragraf gambaran umum yang merangkum pola utama
objectives: Menulis gambaran umum sebelum menyebut angka rinci
Memilih kata untuk menyatakan pola utama

vocab.exampleId: Secara garis besar, rencana itu berhasil.
Pengunjung datang terutama pada musim panas.

vocab.example: The rise was primarily due to demand.

block1.tip: Paragraf gambaran umum tidak memuat angka rinci. Tulis pola utama dengan kata seperti overall atau generally, lalu sebut satu atau dua titik yang paling menonjol.

youtube.videoDescription: Video 10 sampai 15 menit tentang cara menulis overview untuk grafik, dengan contoh pola utama dan kata pembuka yang tepat.
watchFor: Pola utama dan titik yang menonjol

lesson.intro: Overview adalah paragraf singkat yang merangkum pola utama sebuah grafik. Tulis tanpa detail angka, dan fokus pada arah umum, perbedaan utama, dan titik paling menonjol.

sections.heading: Pembuka
sections.bodyMd: Mulai dengan **overall** atau **generally** untuk menyatakan pola umum. Gunakan **broadly** jika ada beberapa pengecualian kecil.

sections.heading: Titik utama
sections.bodyMd: Sebut **key** pattern dengan **notably** atau **prominent** jika ada titik yang sangat jelas. **Noticeable** dipakai untuk perubahan yang mudah dilihat.

sections.heading: Penyebab dan kelompok
sections.bodyMd: **Chiefly**, **primarily**, dan **mainly** dipakai untuk menyebut bagian terbesar atau alasan utama. Jangan memakai detail yang belum diminta.

block3.title: Gambaran Umum Kunjungan Wisata
block3.text:
The chart illustrates the number of tourists who visited a coastal region between 2015 and 2020. Overall, the figures show a steady increase, although there was a clear interruption in one year. The overview below highlights the key patterns without repeating every value.

Generally speaking, visitors came from three main sources: domestic travellers, regional visitors, and international tourists. Broadly, domestic travellers made up the largest group in every year. Notably, their numbers rose most sharply between 2016 and 2018, when new ferry routes opened to the islands.

International tourists were a smaller group, but their share grew faster than any other category. Their arrivals came chiefly in the summer months, and this pattern was consistent across all five years. The increase was primarily driven by better flight connections and a stronger marketing campaign.

Regional visitors remained relatively stable. Their number changed only slightly from year to year, and the category was mainly used for short trips and weekend stays. Although this group was not the largest, it was a noticeable part of local hotel income.

The most prominent feature of the chart is the sharp drop in 2020. In that year, arrivals fell in every category, and the decline was most severe for international tourists. This is the only point where the trend clearly reversed, and it stands out against the earlier growth.

Taken together, the figures suggest that tourism in the region depends heavily on domestic demand. The key lesson for planners is that a diversified market is less exposed to shocks. A region that relies on one group of visitors may suffer when that group reduces its travel.

It is also worth noting that the chart does not show spending per visitor. As a result, the overview describes the number of visits rather than the economic value of tourism. A fuller report would need additional data on income and length of stay before it could judge the total impact. Readers should also keep in mind that the figures were collected by the regional tourism office, which updates the data each year. The pattern in the last two years was therefore shaped by external factors rather than by changes in the region's attractions.
